title: Clubhouse Home, Parent Portal Dashboard, and Tours & Interviews Booking (Frontend)

requirements.summary: Establish a cohesive, family-friendly “interactive digital playground” visual theme (warm sunny palette, rounded bubbles, star/butterfly accents, consistent typography/spacing).
acceptanceCriteria: All three pages share the same design language (rounded bubble containers, consistent palette, consistent typography).
Primary palette is not predominantly blue/purple.
Star/butterfly decorative elements appear in a consistent style across pages.

file_operations.description: Create global styling foundation (warm sunny palette tokens via CSS variables, typography defaults, spacing rhythm, reusable “bubble container” utility classes). Ensure the primary scheme is not predominantly blue/purple.
Align Tailwind theme extension with the warm sunny palette (map primary/secondary/accent to warm tones) and increase default border radius for bubble-like UI surfaces.
Add a small decorative helper component to place consistent star/butterfly ‘sticker’ accents (positioned, non-interactive) around sections without blocking usability.
Create a reusable rounded ‘bubble’ container component (shadow, border, padding) used across Home, Parent Portal, and Booking pages for consistent layout.

requirements.summary: Implement the Clubhouse Home page with a sunny-park hero and a giant “Join the Club” primary CTA.
acceptanceCriteria: Home page includes a hero image visually resembling a sunny park.
The primary CTA is labeled exactly “Join the Club” and is visually dominant on the page.
Home page uses rounded bubble containers and star accents in the layout.

file_operations.description: Create the Clubhouse Home page layout: hero section rendering the sunny park image, bubble-like content sections, star accents, and a visually dominant primary button labeled exactly “Join the Club”.
Wire the Clubhouse Home route and ensure navigation can reach it from the UI (header links/buttons).

requirements.summary: Add routing and visible navigation so users can reach Home, Parent Portal Dashboard, and Tours & Interviews Booking from the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: There are working routes/pages for Home, Parent Portal, and Tours & Interviews.
Users can navigate between all three pages via visible UI navigation (e.g., header buttons/links).

file_operations.description: Create an app shell with a playful header/navigation that links to Clubhouse Home, Parent Portal, and Tours & Interviews Booking; keep styling consistent with the bubble theme.
Add route definitions for the three pages and wrap them in the AppShell so navigation is visible on all pages.
Create the Parent Portal page component and ensure it is registered with routing (content gated per REQ-5).
Create the Tours & Interviews booking page component and ensure it is registered with routing.

requirements.summary: Build the Parent Portal Dashboard UI with a VIP feel: nanny cam centerpiece with playful frame plus Nap/Snack/Play quick-glance widgets populated from backend data (or clear placeholder).
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard visually emphasizes the nanny cam area as the main focal element and includes a playful frame/border around it.
Dashboard includes three distinct quick-glance status widgets labeled exactly “Nap”, “Snack”, and “Play”.
Backend provides an API to read the current values/timestamps for Nap/Snack/Play statuses and the nanny cam media URL (or placeholder).
Frontend fetches and displays statuses from the backend and shows a nanny cam area (real URL if configured, otherwise a clear placeholder).

file_operations.description: Implement the VIP Lounge dashboard layout: large nanny cam area as the focal point, render the fun frame graphic around it, and show three distinct status widgets labeled exactly “Nap”, “Snack”, and “Play”. Include a clear placeholder state for the nanny cam if no media URL is configured/available.
Create a presentational component that wraps an embedded media area with the generated fun frame graphic while keeping the feed area non-clinical and playful.
Create a component to render the quick-glance ‘Nap’, ‘Snack’, and ‘Play’ widgets, including use of the generated status icons image and display fields for values/timestamps.

Add a React Query hook that uses the existing actor (via useActor) to retrieve nanny-cam/status data once the backend capability exists; until then, return a stable placeholder model so the UI remains functional.

requirements.summary: Require Internet Identity sign-in before viewing Parent Portal and show a friendly signed-out state; do not edit immutable Internet Identity hook files.
acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to access the Parent Portal while signed out displays a sign-in prompt and does not display portal content.
After signing in with Internet Identity, the Parent Portal page becomes accessible.
No edits are made to immutable Internet Identity hook files; authentication is composed using existing hooks/components.

file_operations.description: Create an auth guard wrapper that checks authentication via the existing useInternetIdentity hook and conditionally renders either (a) a friendly sign-in prompt or (b) the protected Parent Portal content. Use the selected ‘authorization’ component’s frontend guidance for composing authentication state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a friendly, on-brand sign-in panel (warm palette, bubble container) with a button that triggers Internet Identity login/logout using the existing useInternetIdentity hook. Use the selected ‘authorization’ component’s frontend guidance for login/logout and clearing cached data with React Query. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wrap the dashboard content in RequireAuth so signed-out users see only the sign-in state and not the portal content.
Ensure the Parent Portal route uses the auth guard so the access-control flow applies when navigating directly via URL or via header navigation.

requirements.summary: Implement Tours & Interviews Booking page with calendar UI, adjacent “Meet Auntie Maia” media area, and star/butterfly sticker decorations.
acceptanceCriteria: Booking page includes a calendar-style scheduling UI.
A “Meet Auntie Maia” media area (photo or video) is displayed adjacent to the calendar on desktop widths and stacks sensibly on mobile.
Decorative star/butterfly sticker visuals appear around the calendar area without obstructing usability.

file_operations.description: Build the booking page layout with a responsive two-column arrangement (calendar left, ‘Meet Auntie Maia’ media right on desktop; stacked on mobile). Add sticker-style star/butterfly decorations around the calendar region without blocking interactions.
Create a calendar-style scheduling component that supports selecting a date/time and emitting a requested time value for submission.
Create the ‘Meet Auntie Maia’ media panel that renders the generated portrait asset and optional video placeholder area, styled consistently with bubble containers.

requirements.summary: Enable booking request submission and listing from the booking page; show a clear confirmation state after submit.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes methods to create a booking request and list booking requests for the signed-in user (by Principal).
Frontend can submit a booking request from the calendar UI and shows a clear confirmation after successful submission.
Booking requests persist in canister state and are retrievable on refresh.

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for (1) creating a booking request and (2) listing booking requests using the existing actor (via useActor). Prefer showing only the current user’s items in the UI (filter client-side using identity principal if needed) while relying on backend authorization for correctness.

Wire the BookingCalendar selection into a submit action that calls the booking-create capability and then shows a clear confirmation state; also render a ‘Your requests’ list sourced from the list capability and refresh it after submission and on reload.
Add a small confirmation component/state UI that clearly indicates a booking request was submitted successfully and summarizes the selected date/time and details.

requirements.summary: Add generated images as static frontend assets and render them on the Home, Parent Portal, and Booking pages (hero, stickers, frame, icons, and Auntie Maia portrait).
acceptanceCriteria: All generated images are stored under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Home page uses the generated sunny park hero image.
Parent Portal uses the generated fun frame around the nanny cam area.
Booking page uses the generated sticker assets around the calendar area.

file_operations.description: Add the generated sunny park hero illustration as a static asset at the required path.
Add the generated star sticker set as a static asset at the required path.
Add the generated butterfly sticker set as a static asset at the required path.
Add the generated fun rounded frame border graphic as a static asset at the required path.
Add the generated quick-glance status icons strip as a static asset at the required path.
Add the generated ‘Auntie Maia’ portrait placeholder as a static asset at the required path.
Render the generated hero image from frontend/public/assets/generated/clubhouse-hero-sunny-park.dim_1600x900.png within the hero section.
Use frontend/public/assets/generated/nanny-cam-fun-frame.dim_1200x800.png to visually frame the nanny cam area.
Use frontend/public/assets/generated/status-icons-nap-snack-play.dim_768x256.png to visually support the ‘Nap’, ‘Snack’, and ‘Play’ widgets.

Place decorative stickers around the calendar region using frontend/public/assets/generated/stickers-stars-set.dim_1024x1024.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/stickers-butterflies-set.dim_1024x1024.png without obstructing usability.
Render the ‘Meet Auntie Maia’ portrait using frontend/public/assets/generated/meet-auntie-maia-portrait.dim_800x800.png.
